heroHeadline: Indonesia 2026: Military Returns to Civilian Roles as Papua Crisis Deepens
heroSubtitle: Under President Prabowo, Indonesia's parliament expanded military access to civilian posts in April 2026 — reviving echoes of Suharto's dwifungsi doctrine — while 83,177 security forces remain deployed across Papua amid an IDP crisis of 107,000+ displaced civilians. A landmark US defense partnership and a record $40B palm oil export year underscore Indonesia's strategic balancing act in an increasingly contested Indo-Pacific.
footerNote: Data sourced from Sekretariat Negara RI, BPS Statistics Indonesia, Komnas HAM, World Bank, Project Multatuli, Human Rights Monitor, and verified academic historical sources.
